Is it difficult to even propose an anti-discrimination law?
Amidst these challenging circumstances, Representative Son Sol of the Progressive Party has introduced the first anti-discrimination law in the 22nd National Assembly.
The anti-discrimination law, at the forefront of South Korean democracy, is only the beginning; now it must move toward enactment. We need your help and support, both inside and outside the National Assembly. Please join us!

ko.description:

en-US.title: A New Textbook on the Korean Economy Through the Eyes of Workers
en-US.description:
"Korean Economics for Workers"

If we were to rewrite the history of the Korean economy, whose perspective should it be?

A new textbook on the Korean economy, seen through the eyes of workers, rather than through the language of growth and efficiency.

📚 See pinned comment for book purchase information.

This book overturns the perspective of existing economics textbooks, which have interpreted the history of the Korean economy solely as a success story of entrepreneurs and those in power.
Author Na Won-jun sought to write "an economics that stands on the side of the working class, who, behind the scenes of dazzling success, have been subjected to exclusion, inequality, and exploitation by imperialism and monopoly capital."
